answer: An attacker spinning up thousands of fake identities must burn equivalent compute per identity, making mass infiltration economically irrational. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work registration: each new agent must solve a computational puzzle whose difficulty scales with network size, costing real CPU-hours. Like pigment deepening a sable coat, each solved block leaves an indelible cost trail, and the barrier grows hard as a glacier over time. From once0010's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
